name: Cabanabona (Spain)
description: Light green field charged at the centre with a yellow stone hut with a black doorway.
history: The official flag of Cabanabona is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, light green, with the yellow hut of the arms, closed in black, 3/6 of the height of the cloth, at the centre; approved by the Generalitat on 17 November 2014 and published in the DOGC on 28 November 2014.

features.role: stone hut (cabana) with a black doorway
